title: Correction to: Temporal constraints on leaf-level trait plasticity for next-generation land surface models
content: This is a correction to: A Odé, N G Smith, K T Rebel, H J de Boer, Temporal constraints on leaf-level trait plasticity for next-generation land surface models, Annals of Botany, Volume 136, Issue 2, July 2025, Pages 263–274, https://doi.org/10.1093/aob/mcaf045.
